privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: A summary of how PathUp handles your data. The full policy will be published before launch.
privacy.whoBody: Your name, email and date of birth; your onboarding answers; and, as you use the app, your workouts, wellness check-ins and measurements. Sex, height and photos are always optional.
privacy.whyBody: Only to provide the service: save your progress, recommend programs and adapt your sessions. No ads and no selling data to anyone.
privacy.healthBody: It's a special category under the GDPR (art. 9). We only process it with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw by deleting your account.
privacy.whereBody: On Supabase servers in the European Union (Frankfurt).
privacy.rightsBody: You can download all your data and delete your account whenever you want, from Profile → Your data and your account. People under 16 cannot sign up; from 16 to 17 the profile is always private.

landing.metaTitle: PathUp · Free workouts, guided programs and wellness
landing.metaDescription: Log your workouts, follow a program made for you and look after your recovery. Free and ad-free.

hero.subtitle: Log your workouts, follow a program made for you and look after your recovery. All in one app, with no ads.
hero.tryDemoHint: The demo opens the app with 8 weeks of sample workouts. Nothing is saved.

how.title: From zero to training with a plan, in 4 steps
how.step1Body: Goal, experience, free days and equipment. Two minutes and a short health questionnaire.
how.step2Body: We recommend a program based on your answers. Miss a day and it adjusts instead of wasting the week.
how.step3Body: Log every set in two taps, with last time's weights in front of you and your rest timed.
how.step4Body: A 20-second check-in adapts the session to how you slept, and we tell you when to add weight.

features.title: The best of every app, in one
features.subtitle: What takes three or four different apps today, together and connected.
features.workoutBody: Routines, sets, automatic rest timer, supersets and records. Works with no signal at the gym.
features.programsBody: Multi-week plans with technique explained and the reasoning behind every choice.
features.wellnessBody: Sleep, energy, stress and habits in a check-in that talks to your training.
features.progressBody: Charts per exercise, estimated 1RM, measurements and private photos. No paywalls.
features.nutritionBody: Protein and calories without obsession, barcode scanner and a target that adjusts every week.
features.communityBody: Follow friends, share records and join weekly challenges. Private by default.

principles.title: Built for you to use, not to sell you something
principles.freeBody: No subscription to see your charts and no routine limits.
principles.beginnerBody: A beginner mode that explains every step and gets out of the way once you know what you're doing.
principles.evidenceBody: Programs and progressions backed by research, not trends.
principles.privacyBody: Servers in the EU, private profile by default and explicit consent for your health data.

audiences.title: Wherever you're starting from
audiences.beginnerBody: We tell you what to do each day and how to do it well.
audiences.lifterBody: Fast logging, records and progression without distractions.
audiences.activeBody: Gentle programs at home or in the gym, at any age from 16.

roadmap.title: How PathUp is progressing
roadmap.subtitle: We're building the app in the open. Here's what you can use now and what's coming.
roadmap.sepBody: Account, personalised onboarding and an exercise library with technique.
roadmap.octBody: Offline workout logging, guided programs, progress and wellness.
roadmap.novBody: Nutrition: calories, protein and barcode scanner.
roadmap.decBody: Community: friends, shared records and challenges.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.freeA: Yes. PathUp is free and has no ads.
faq.gymA: No. When you start you tell us what equipment you have and we show you what you can do: gym, dumbbells, bands or just your body.
faq.beginnerQ: I've never trained. Is it for me?
faq.beginnerA: Yes. Every exercise explains how to do it, the key technique cues and the most common mistakes.
faq.ageQ: How old do I need to be?
faq.ageA: 16 or older. Between 16 and 17 profiles are always private and fat-loss goals aren't available.
faq.dataQ: What do you do with my data?
faq.dataA: We only use it to provide the service. It's stored in the European Union and health data requires your explicit consent.
faq.devicesQ: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
faq.devicesA: Yes, from the browser on any phone or computer. The installable Android app arrives during the beta.
